speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. To help determine the cause of your fatigue, flank pain, and fever, could you tell me if you have experienced any pain or burning when you urinate, or noticed any changes in your urine color or frequency?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling tired, feverish, and I have flank pain. These symptoms continued even after my sinus symptoms improved.

speaker: Doctor
text: I understand. Have you noticed any changes in your urine, such as cloudiness, blood, or an unusual odor, and do you have any nausea or vomiting?

speaker: Patient
text: I was first treated with amoxicillin for sinusitis and developed a rash. Then the antibiotic was changed to cephalexin for another week, and the rash went away.

speaker: Doctor
text: That history of a rash after amoxicillin followed by flank pain and fever is very concerning for acute interstitial nephritis, an allergic reaction affecting the kidneys. Do you have any swelling in your legs or face, and have you noticed a decrease in your urine output?

speaker: Patient
text: I do not have nausea, vomiting, or burning with urination. I also have not noticed a major change in urine color.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for confirming those details. Given your recent antibiotic use, rash, and subsequent fever and flank pain without urinary symptoms, I suspect acute interstitial nephritis. REQUEST TEST: Urinalysis, Serum_Creatinine, BUN
